observation: Current Hausmann recipe uses a tall27.5m upper stone drum with three stacked arched-window tiers, then a short tapered lead roof. Both inspected released photographs instead show a shorter single main arched-window tier with small round upper lights, a more substantial rounded lead roof/bulb, open lantern and slender upper needle. A large red/blue clock below the platform is absent from the current model. Existing passed fidelity notes do not prove this geometry correct.
focus: hausmann() and skyline() profiles; keep total100.27m and documented39m platform separate from unmeasured intermediate proportions. Correct main/drum/roof/window/clock hierarchy, regenerate/import all four authored levels and inspect affected current captures.
guards: Assert work ownership and preserve immutable before snapshots before editing; retain original native plan, terrain and placement.

resolution.notes: Three individually inspected Nikater/Ingersoll Ownwork/PD-self original photographs establish the pale western facade, paired corner crowns, red roofs, Great Court and Hausmann hierarchy. Qualla imagery was checked first; all earlier private/attribution and assumed-author sources are excluded from this current review. Corrected the tall three-tier drum to one main arched-window tier with small upper round lights, a fuller rounded lead roof, open lantern, upper bulb and needle; added two red-ring/blue-field clocks below the39m platform. Total100.27m and platform39m are published controls; intermediate tower/clock dimensions remain photographic estimates. Retained mapped full castle, Georgenbau, stable wings and separate Langer Gang. Later glass court roof/hidden rooms follow retained mapped and architectural reconstruction;2005photos do not certify current restoration finish. Fine sculpture, literal clock numerals, paintings, heraldry and construction engineering are outside approximate medium-fi exterior scope.
